x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Do not launch a duplicate helper; audit exact HEAD, parent, changed paths, index, worktree, locks, and owner-started processes before any further mutation.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: The wrapper produced no attributable completion and earned zero lifecycle credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Infer failure or retry the guarded commit path from missing wrapper output.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: The guarded write-tree, commit-tree, and update-ref wrapper returned without attributable output; the immediate audit still showed the first x1 commit, while the later post-interruption audit found the exact repair commit durable.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The later audit found repair commit f7161b026d270a131cc8449e75a7562fe04f0f66 as the direct child of 40c25aeb884fadc96366847507ff79c53d4e95c5, with the reviewed sixteen-path x1-only delta, zero merges, 40/40 owner-manifest parity, and clean four-way-equal pushed state.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Reread the branch after interruption and verify the repair commit, parent, tree, exact delta, and clean state.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: After any unattributed mutating wrapper, poll durable Git state before retrying, including across a user interruption.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Owner-local x1 durable-state recovery only; no history rewrite or independent reproduction.

x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Pin PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 before Unicode-emitting diagnostics or emit an ASCII-safe summary when the exact Unicode payload is not needed.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: The counts printed, then UnicodeEncodeError stopped the remaining diagnostic; it earned zero completion credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Print the complete phase skill and runner specifications through the default PowerShell Python stream.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: A read-only Python diagnostic computed the expected portfolio counts but failed while emitting a skill or runner specification containing Māori text through the default Windows CP1252 stream.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The UTF-8-pinned diagnostic completed and confirmed 30 proposals, 30 safe tasks, 20 candidate tasks, 30 CLEAN tasks, 10 skill specifications, and 10 runner specifications.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Repeat only the bounded read-only diagnostic with PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 and verify the declared counts.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Set UTF-8 explicitly before repository diagnostics that may emit Māori text.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Read-only encoding recovery only; no repository, route, sibling, or external state mutation.

x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Pass an explicit Python string list or serialize and parse valid JSON.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: The inventory stopped with NameError before loading or running any test and earned zero validation credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Inject the PowerShell module array directly into an inline Python assignment.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: A read-only unittest inventory embedded a PowerShell array into Python without JSON string quoting, so Python treated the first module prefix as an undefined name.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The quoted inventory completed without executing tests and counted 11 current-x1, 41 current-x2, 5 Caelen-successor, 8 Caelen-final, and 8 Sable-final cases.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_procedure: Load an explicit quoted module list and count test cases without executing them.
x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Never interpolate a PowerShell array directly into Python source.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Read-only test inventory recovery only; no test execution or repository mutation.

x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Enumerate paths with rg --files, filter the names, then pass exact literal paths.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: Ripgrep reported Windows error 123 and the content search earned zero evidence credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Pass a wildcard-bearing Windows path directly as the ripgrep search operand.
x2_operational_negatives.failure_signature: A read-only ripgrep command passed scripts/*v657_v5*.py as a literal Windows path operand, which Windows rejected before content search.
x2_operational_negatives.pass_observed: The rg --files recovery identified the exact Caelen detailed, minimal, and final validator paths and inspected their check-count surfaces without error.

x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Do not rely on POSIX wildcard expansion for Windows ripgrep path operands.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Read-only validator inventory recovery only; no repository mutation.

x2_operational_negatives.candidate_workaround: Retain the partial result, audit owned processes and exact artifacts, then rerun only the receipt builder with a bounded longer supervision window.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_observed: Three preliminary receipts existed, but evidence-content-manifest.json was absent; the attempt earned zero manifest credit.
x2_operational_negatives.fail_procedure: Infer complete receipt construction from the silent builder wrapper.

x2_operational_negatives.recurrence_guard: Treat absent builder output as zero evidence until every required durable artifact is inspected.
x2_operational_negatives.scope_boundary: Owner-local evidence-receipt recovery only; no test, route, sibling, or external-state credit.
